entries.scope: Dependabot configuration and repository-specific update ownership

readerPaths: Dependabot configuration -> maintenance guide -> run or alert -> reviewed PR
entries.navigationImpact: Configuration header points to the bilingual guide; the guide links back to the configuration and monitoring pages.

entries.reevaluationTrigger: New manifests, changed paths, pins or maintenance ownership
